name: junglescout-mcp
description: Amazon keyword volumes, product database, sales estimates, and share of voice via Jungle Scout
long_description: Gives Claude live access to the Jungle Scout Developer API: exact and broad keyword search volumes with trends and PPC bids, keywords driving any ASIN, product database queries with revenue filters, per-day sales estimates, and brand share of voice. Requires a Jungle Scout plan with API access.
